fields.label: CIN of Company
fields.description: Corporate Identity Number of the company
fields.instruction: Extract the 21-character CIN of the company.

fields.label: Name of Company
fields.instruction: Extract the name of the company.

fields.label: Authorized Capital
fields.instruction: Extract authorized capital from Balance Sheet or Directors Report.

fields.label: Share Capital (Current)
fields.description: Share Capital at the end of current period
fields.instruction: Extract Share Capital or Equity Share Capital for current FY.

fields.label: Share Capital (Previous)
fields.description: Share Capital at the end of previous period
fields.instruction: Extract Share Capital or Equity Share Capital for previous FY.

fields.label: Reserves & Surplus (Current)
fields.instruction: Extract Reserves & Surplus for current FY.

fields.label: Reserves & Surplus (Previous)
fields.instruction: Extract Reserves & Surplus for previous FY.

fields.label: Net Worth of Company
fields.instruction: Compute Net Worth = Share Capital + Reserves & Surplus.

fields.label: Revenue from Operations (Current)
fields.instruction: Extract Revenue from Operations or Turnover for current FY.

fields.label: Revenue from Operations (Previous)
fields.description: Revenue from operations in previous period
fields.instruction: Extract Revenue from Operations or Turnover for previous FY.

fields.label: Auditor Name
fields.instruction: Extract the Auditor or Audit Firm Name.

fields.label: Auditor Membership/FRN
fields.description: Membership number or Firm Registration number
fields.instruction: Extract Auditor Membership Number or FRN.

fields.label: Date of Board Report Signing
fields.instruction: Extract date of signing the Board Report or Financial Statements by directors.

fields.label: Date of Board Meeting
fields.description: Date of board meeting approving reports
fields.instruction: Extract date of board meeting approving accounts.

rules.message: Net Worth of Company must equal Share Capital plus Reserves & Surplus.
Date of Board Meeting must be chronologically on or before the Date of Signing.
